organization.name_ja: 株式会社富士山マガジンサービス

affected.note: Maximum number of customers whose address-book information registered in My Page may have been accessed via 8 customer accounts that were logged into without authorization. The first notice (2025-06-20) gave 2,528,491 people and 9 accounts; the investigation completed on 2025-08-15 revised these to 2,259,434 and 8. Payment data such as card and bank account details was not included.

summary.en: Fujisan Magazine Service, which runs the magazine subscription site Fujisan.co.jp, detected mass access mainly from overseas from 2025-05-31 and later found unauthorized logins to customer My Pages. Attackers used those accounts to run a program against other customers' address-book pages, and up to 2,259,434 customers' address data may have been accessed.
summary.ja: 雑誌定期購読サイト「Fujisan.co.jp」を運営する富士山マガジンサービスは、2025年5月31日から主に海外からの大量アクセスを検知し、その後顧客の「マイページ」への不正ログインが判明した。不正ログインされたアカウントを起点に他の顧客の住所録ページが攻撃され、最大2,259,434人の住所情報にアクセスされた可能性があると公表した。
